Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of a medial section; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with the additional adhesive layer.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal honeycomb structure.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the ring includes __a__ central opening. 

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments.

Claim 294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
